title: test(ui): size the whole-tree CLI case of check-pending-changeset-literals to its measured cost
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDypKu7B9nwbu5WuV7AEio8)_

Fixes #38072

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改了界面仓库里一条内部测试的时间上限,产品行为前后一致。
- 为什么做:每 4 小时一次的全量测试在主干上红了一次,这条整树扫描的测试在繁忙的机器上超过了 15 秒,这里按实测成本给它留出时间。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是这条测试仍偶尔超时、主干再红一次;改动只有一行上限加一段说明,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts`, case "3. the tree as it stands satisfies the rule › exits 0 through the CLI": an explicit per-case timeout of `60_000` ms, with a comment naming the measurement it is sized from. The case still runs the real gate over the whole tree through the CLI; nothing is skipped, narrowed or deleted (triage ruling 7231819297).

Measurement the number is sized from:

| Where | Reading |
|:---|:---|
| local, quiet 4-core box, gate CLI alone, 3 runs (commit 24e94bb7) | 3264 / 3060 / 3042 ms |
| local, the case under vitest | 3355 ms |
| CI Test UI 1/16, green 4-hourly run 46060926437, whole file | 4365 ms |
| CI Test UI 1/16, red 4-hourly run 46086203867 (job 140796965590), whole file | 15707 ms, case timed out at 15000 ms |
| CI Test UI 1/16, red PR run 46013507104 (job 140557010537), whole file | 16049 ms, case timed out at 15000 ms |

The red shards were heavily loaded (shard Duration 723 s and 918 s, import 1146 s and 1460 s). The worst reading is about 5x the local cost; 60 s keeps about 4x over it. The precedent followed is the sibling per-case `}, 60_000);` in `body-dialect-census.test.ts` and `body-dialect-producer-scan.test.ts` (a tree-wide scan with an explicit per-case timeout and a comment naming the measurement, not a global `testTimeout` bump).

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose scripts/__tests__/check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 15 passed (15); the case 3355 ms (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts` (after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`): VERDICT command-exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/AGENTS.md` says not to fix a flaky test by raising its timeout, because a raised timeout hides a race. There is no race here: the case is one synchronous child process doing a fixed amount of work (the whole-tree scan), and its cost scales with runner load. The triage ruling explicitly allows "a timeout matched to the measured cost", and the sibling scans in `ui/scripts/__tests__/` already do this.
- Gate cost: about 3.2 s of the CLI's time is `deriveCandidates` in `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` (import 7 ms). It already skips `node_modules`, `dist`, `.git`, `.turbo`, `coverage`, `build` and `.next`, and finds 77 entries. That is real work on test sources, not a wasteful walk, and that file is outside this card's surface, so it is not changed here.
- `execFileSync` blocks the event loop, so vitest can only judge the timeout after the child returns. A gate that never terminates would hang the shard until the job timeout, with or without this change.
- On the red shards the whole file crossed the 10 s per-file line that `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs` reports on (`FILE_BUDGET_SECONDS`). The green reading is 4.4 s, so this file declares no `test-budget:` header here. If the weekly refresh lists it, that is a separate card.

## Verification

Read first: the one hunk in `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts` (the `60_000` and the comment above it).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts`. Expect 15 passed, with "exits 0 through the CLI" at about 3 s.
